subject.title: [Feature] Configurable thinking/reasoning block format per channel

question: Should visible reasoning presentation become a portable agent preference, a Telegram-owned preference, or remain a fixed product format?
rationale: Source proves that configurability is missing, but it cannot determine the permanent config owner, precedence between agent and channel settings, or cross-channel fallback semantics.

options.title: Portable Preference
options.body: Add one typed reasoning-presentation preference used consistently by core delivery paths and mapped through each channel's supported formatting capabilities.

options.title: Telegram Preference
options.body: Add the option only to the Telegram plugin, limiting scope while accepting channel-specific presentation divergence.

options.title: Keep Fixed Format
options.body: Avoid another config surface and instead select one readable built-in presentation for all reasoning-capable channel surfaces.

recommendation.title: Portable Preference
recommendation.body: Add one typed reasoning-presentation preference used consistently by core delivery paths and mapped through each channel's supported formatting capabilities.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared reasoning implementation history and prior product review on this issue make this the strongest available owner for the direction decision.
